description: Publish a saved scene to a PUBLIC, shareable URL so anyone can view it in 3D in a browser — no login required. PUBLISHING IS PARTLY IRREVERSIBLE: the URL is submitted to search engines (IndexNow) the moment it goes live, so it may appear in results even after a takedown. ALWAYS confirm with the user first, then call with confirm:true — without it this tool publishes nothing and returns what WOULD happen. Returns the public site URL plus a per-page URL list. Re-publishing the SAME scene updates its existing public site (the URL stays stable).

confirm.description: Must be exactly true to publish. Omit / false to get a needsConfirm summary for the user.

confirmReplace.description: Only after a reply with needsConfirm and willReplace: exactly true replaces that live site with this scene. Ask the user first, naming the site.

listed.description: false publishes UNLISTED: reachable by its link, but kept off Explore and your creator profile, marked noindex and not submitted to search engines. Omit for a normal listed publish.

shortLink.description: true also returns shortUrl, a short 3dcms.info/s/<code> link to the site (one stable code per site), for sharing and QR codes.

siteSlug.description: Publish onto one of YOUR existing sites by its slug (the part after /sites/ in its URL) instead of this scene's own. When that site shows another scene, the first call answers willReplace: name the site to the user and call again with confirmReplace:true on a yes. Later publishes of this scene go to that site.

name: publish_scene
title: Publish a 3dCMS scene
